questions.question: Choose the correct relative pronoun: 'The woman ___ called you yesterday is my aunt.'
In a non-defining relative clause, the relative pronoun 'that' can replace 'which' or 'who'.
Identifie et corrige l'erreur dans la phrase suivante : 'The Eiffel Tower, that was built in 1889, is located in Paris.'
Which sentence contains a NON-DEFINING relative clause?
choices: The student who studies hardest will pass.
Paris, which is the capital of France, is a beautiful city.
The book that I borrowed was very interesting.
Do you know the man who lives next door?

questions.question: In a defining relative clause, the relative pronoun can sometimes be omitted when it is the object of the clause.
Combine les deux phrases en une seule à l'aide d'une proposition relative : 'I have a friend. Her mother is a famous actress.'
Choose the correct sentence using 'where' as a relative pronoun.
choices: That's the school where I studied for five years.
That's the school which I studied for five years.
That's the school who I studied for five years.
That's the school when I studied for five years.

questions.question: The sentence 'My sister, who is a doctor, works in London' can be rewritten without commas and keep the same meaning.

exercisenotion.description: Une relative déterminative identifie précisément le nom qu'elle qualifie. Sans elle, la phrase perdrait son sens principal. Pas de virgules. On peut utiliser who/that (personnes), which/that (choses), whose (possession).

Une relative non-déterminative apporte une information supplémentaire sur un nom déjà identifié. Elle est encadrée par des virgules. On N'utilise PAS 'that'. Ex : My brother, who lives in London, is a doctor.

exercisenotion.notion: Pronoms relatifs : who, which, whose, where, when, that
exercisenotion.description: who = personnes (sujet), whom = personnes (complément), which = choses/animaux, whose = possession, where = lieu, when = temps, that = personnes ou choses (uniquement dans les relatives déterminatives).
